finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07. All of it flows from there.
Cache off, every read hit the store. Timeouts began 3 seconds later.
Queue grew 52 to 568. It passed the 500 cap at 02:29:12.
13 reconnect tries, all refused, 80s apart. None worked.
worker-2 died on heap OOM. api was killed at 02:31:52.

```
2026-07-04T02:14:07.113Z ERROR [api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
2026-07-04T02:31:44.902Z ERROR [worker-2] JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)
2026-07-04T02:31:52.318Z FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down
```

Fix Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 first.
